payload.title: India's Cricket World Cup Finals Journey and Player Participation

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: India has appeared in four Cricket World Cup finals (2003, 2011, 2023) and finished as runners-up on three occasions. The team won the titles in 1983 and 2011.

sections.heading: Players
sections.body: Sachin Tendulkar, Virender Sehwag and Harbhajan Singh featured in the 2003 and 2011 ODI World Cup finals [E9][E10][E11]. Each player's progression to the finals is documented with citations [R5].

sections.heading: Approaches and trends
sections.body: India's pattern shows early finals appearances (2003) followed by a home-win in 2011, then back-to-back semifinal exits in 2019 and 2023 despite strong group-stage performances. The team remained undefeated en route to the 2023 final before losing to Australia [E8].

citations.span: Harbhajan played in the finals of 2003 and 2011 ODI World Cups.

Like Bhajji, Sehwag also played 4 ICC finals; 2002 Champions Trophy followed by 2003 ODI World Cup, 2007 T20 and 
2011 ODI World Cup.
Legendary Tendulkar played in the finals of 2000 and 2002 Champions Trophy. He appeared in 2003 and 2011 ODI World Cup finals as well.

In the 2023 edition hosted exclusively by India, the Rohit Sharma-led Indian team did not lose a single match en route to the final. In the fourth final appearance at the World Cups, India lost to Australia and finished as runners-up for the second time.
